headline: Verification—not code generation—is the iOS constraint
synthesis: The remaining sources converge on a tighter signal: iOS agents become useful only when teams bound the task and make verification explicit. Vivian Qu centers a build-run-inspect loop; DoorDash shows how exact migration rules and repeated clean test runs turn a large change into reviewable work; SWE-Bench Mobile shows that harness design can change results dramatically while overall success remains low. JP Simard adds an architectural boundary: share product intent across platforms, but preserve native implementations and native ownership. The practical priority is therefore to improve the agent’s environment, evidence, and review loop before expanding autonomy.
